title: STCO: Conditional Neural Operators for Time-Dependent PDEs
abstract: arXiv:2608.20477v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Neural operators have emerged as efficient surrogates for time-dependent physical systems governed by partial differential equations (PDEs), but their future-state predictions are often conditioned only on observed states and static problem descriptors. For control or optimization, however, body motion, inflow, or forcing are prescribed for the query without being determined solely by the observed state. We introduce the Spatiotemporal Conditional Operator (STCO) for prescribed-condition operator learning (PCOL), a common interface that supplies prescribed target-time condition fields to heterogeneous backbone architectures while retaining their architecture-specific core computation and context pathways. Its condition interface combines Flow-Aware Graph Leaf (FAGL) with Dual-Site Feature-wise Linear Modulation (DSFiLM). translated_title: STCO：用于时间依赖偏微分方程的条件神经算子
translated_abstract: 神经算子已成为由偏微分方程控制的时间依赖物理系统的高效替代模型，但其未来状态预测通常仅基于观测状态和静态问题描述符进行条件化。然而，在控制或优化中，物体运动、流入或强制力是在查询时指定的，并非仅由观测状态决定。我们引入了时空条件算子（STCO）用于指定条件算子学习（PCOL），这是一个通用接口，可将指定的目标时间条件场提供给异构骨干架构，同时保留其架构特定的核心计算和上下文路径。其条件接口结合了流感知图叶（FAGL）和双站点特征线性调制（DSFiLM）。非学习的FAGL使用最终观测帧中的涡量来构建固定基数的自适应分区，该分区...
tldr: 本文提出了一种时空条件算子（STCO），通过通用条件接口（结合FAGL和DSFiLM）将指定的目标时间条件场集成到异构神经算子中，解决了时间依赖PDE预测中控制或优化场景下条件仅由观测状态决定的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the Spatiotemporal Conditional Operator (STCO), which integrates prescribed target-time condition fields into heterogeneous neural operators via a general condition interface (combining FAGL and DSFiLM), addressing the issue in time-dependent PDE prediction where conditions in control or optimization scenarios are not solely determined by observed states.
